items.t: Engine knock, oil loss and engine failure
items.job: Replace engine with new, remanufactured or used 3.3L V6
items.note: Owners report about $8,000-12,000 at shops. A used engine costs less. Check with a Kia dealer for any coverage first.

items.t: Front lower control arms rust and break (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace front lower control arms under recall

items.t: ABS module can short and catch fire (recall)
items.job: ABS module recall repair

items.t: Alternator fails after oil leak soaks it
items.job: Replace alternator (fix oil leak separately)
items.note: Owners report about $300 on average for the alternator; sealing the oil leak above it adds cost.

items.t: Hood can open while driving (recall)
items.job: Replace or clean and lubricate secondary hood latch under recall

items.t: Brake lights stay on or won't light (recall)
items.job: Replace brake light switch under recall

items.t: Brake light switch wiring can chafe (recall)
items.job: Repair and reroute brake light switch wiring under recall

items.t: Rear brake hoses can rub and break (recall)
items.job: Replace rear brake hoses under recall

items.t: Fuel rail can crack and leak (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel rail under recall
items.note: Owners who paid before the recall report about $600.

items.t: Airbag control unit may short in a crash (recall)
items.job: Airbag control unit recall repair

items.t: Easy to steal: no engine immobilizer on key-start vans
items.job: Kia anti-theft software update at dealer

items.t: Throttle cable can stick (recall)
items.job: Replace or sleeve throttle cable under recall

items.t: Rear wheel bearings damaged by water (recall)
items.job: Replace rear hub caps and damaged bearings under recall

items.t: ABS programming lengthens low-speed stops (recall)
items.job: Reprogram ABS module under recall

items.t: Rear seat belt anchor bolts and seat strikers (recall)
items.job: Replace anchor bolts and seat strikers under recall

items.t: Alternator failure
items.job: Replace alternator
items.note: Owners report about $1,000 on average at shops.

items.t: Brake noise and fast brake wear
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors
items.note: Owners report about $700 on average, often including more than one axle.

items.t: Steering suddenly stiff or binding
items.job: Diagnose and repair power steering (pump or hoses)
items.note: Owners report about $400 on average; a steering rack costs more.

items.t: Power sliding door may not reverse when blocked (recall)
items.job: Power sliding door recall update

items.t: Passenger seat occupant sensor wiring breaks (recall)
items.job: Repair occupant detection wiring under recall

items.t: Turn signal flashes the wrong direction (recall)
items.job: Smart junction box software update under recall

items.t: Van may roll away after shifting to Park (recall)
items.job: Shift lever repair under recall

items.t: Airbag control unit cover can damage the circuit (recall)
items.job: Airbag control unit recall repair

items.t: Second-row middle seat belt buckle on wrong side (recall)
items.job: Reinstall second-row seat belt buckle under recall

items.t: Loose alternator cable nut can cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect and tighten alternator B+ nut under recall
